# llms.txt - TalkToMeJohnny
# Machine-readable install and usage instructions for AI assistants.

## METADATA
```yaml
name: talktomejohnny
aliases:
  - talktomeclaude
description: Local-first voice medium for Claude Code and Codex CLI. Speech-to-text and speech output stay local. Exact-session attachment is handled by deterministic hooks.
repo: https://github.com/Fredasterehub/talktomejohnny
license: MIT
version: 0.1.4
entrypoint: talktomejohnny
```

## COMPATIBILITY
```yaml
legacy_aliases:
  cli: talktomeclaude
  python_import: talktomeclaude
  config_dir: ~/.config/talktomeclaude/
  cache_dir: ~/.cache/talktomeclaude/
  voice_registry: ~/.config/talktomeclaude/voices.json
  voice_refs: ~/.config/talktomeclaude/voice-refs/
note: Existing settings, voice references, and caches must be copied forward non-destructively during the migration. Do not strand or delete legacy data on first run.
```

## REQUIREMENTS
```yaml
python: ">=3.11"
system:
  windows: "Native user lifecycle hooks execute the installed TalkToMeJohnny console command; Git Bash is not required."
  linux: "libportaudio2 + git"
  macos: "git via Xcode Command Line Tools on first use"
assistant_hosts:
  claude_code: "required only if you want the Claude voice loop"
  codex_cli: "required only if you want the Codex voice loop"
```

## INSTALL_WINDOWS
```yaml
steps:
  - cmd: 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"'
  - cmd: 'git clone https://github.com/Fredasterehub/talktomejohnny.git'
  - cmd: 'cd talktomejohnny'
  - cmd: 'uv venv --python 3.12'
  - cmd: 'uv pip install -e .'
  - cmd: '.\.venv\Scripts\talktomejohnny --help'
```

## INSTALL_MACOS
```yaml
steps:
  - cmd: 'curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh'
  - cmd: 'git clone https://github.com/Fredasterehub/talktomejohnny.git'
  - cmd: 'cd talktomejohnny'
  - cmd: 'uv venv --python 3.12'
  - cmd: 'uv pip install -e .'
  - cmd: './.venv/bin/talktomejohnny --help'
```

## INSTALL_LINUX
```yaml
steps:
  - cmd: 'sudo apt install -y libportaudio2 git'
  - cmd: 'curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh'
  - cmd: 'git clone https://github.com/Fredasterehub/talktomejohnny.git'
  - cmd: 'cd talktomejohnny'
  - cmd: 'uv venv --python 3.12'
  - cmd: 'uv pip install -e .'
  - cmd: 'uv pip install -e ".[cuda]"'
  - cmd: './.venv/bin/talktomejohnny --help'
```

## ACTIVATION
```yaml
install_user_hooks:
  - talktomejohnny hook install --provider claude
  - talktomejohnny hook install --provider codex
claude_code:
  normal_launch: claude
  exact_attach_commands:
    - /talktomejohnny on
    - /talktomejohnny off
    - /talktomejohnny status
codex_cli:
  normal_launch: codex
  trust_installed_hooks: /hooks
  exact_attach_commands:
    - $talktomejohnny on
    - $talktomejohnny off
    - $talktomejohnny status
policy:
  - One attached session is active globally at a time.
  - Claude and Codex reply streams remain isolated.
  - Ordinary claude and codex launches stay silent until explicitly attached.
  - Detach stops future completions from being spoken; an already accepted in-flight reply may still finish.
  - If the companion or host lease is offline or stale, fail closed instead of replaying backlog.
```

## TOPOLOGY
```yaml
local_first:
  desc: "Mic, STT, TTS, and UI on the machine the user sits at."
remote_assistant:
  desc: "Voice on the local machine, assistant on a remote host over SSH."
  setup:
    - "install the assistant CLI on the remote host"
    - "set up passwordless SSH"
    - "configure the remote host and project directory"
    - "launch the voice loop"
```

## USAGE
```yaml
commands:
  dashboard: 'talktomejohnny'
  companion: 'talktomejohnny companion'
  companion_headless: 'talktomejohnny companion --headless'
  legacy_tui: 'talktomejohnny tui'
  speak: 'talktomejohnny speak "text" [--out file.wav] [--voice NAME]'
  listen: 'talktomejohnny listen [--mode always-on|push-to-talk|push-toggle] [--remote user@host] [--remote-cwd PATH] [--once]'
  transcribe: 'talktomejohnny transcribe AUDIO [--device auto|cuda|cpu] [--show-tier]'
  filter: 'talktomejohnny filter transcript.jsonl'
  voices: 'talktomejohnny voices [--download]'
  voice_create: 'talktomejohnny voice create NAME --reference PATH --no-sample'
  config_set: 'talktomejohnny config set recording-mode|voice-assist|assistant-provider|remote|remote-cwd VALUE'
  config_get: 'talktomejohnny config get recording-mode|voice-assist|assistant-provider|remote|remote-cwd'
  assist: 'talktomejohnny assist on|off|status'
```

## WINDOWS_COMPANION
```yaml
support: Windows 11 only
delivery_contract: "The user chooses the exact terminal and cursor location. The companion captures that target for one delivery, revalidates it before paste/Enter, and discards it after completion."
exact_attach_model:
  claude_code: "/talktomejohnny on|off|status"
  codex_cli: "$talktomejohnny on|off|status"
recovery:
  - "talktomejohnny companion --headless"
  - "talktomejohnny tui"
```

## VOICES
```yaml
notes:
  - "All bundled voices are public domain."
  - "Voice downloads are cached locally and should be reused."
  - "Existing voice references must be reused during the migration."
```

## GOTCHAS
```yaml
windows_hooks:
  note: "User lifecycle hooks resolve and pin the installed TalkToMeJohnny executable. Windows encodes only that absolute invocation and fixed hook arguments for noninteractive PowerShell so Bash-hosted Claude hooks preserve the path and JSON transport."
  recovery: "Re-run the provider-specific hook install command. In Codex, open /hooks, review the TalkToMeJohnny entries, and trust their current definitions."
security:
  note: "Do not store secrets, tokens, private voice material, or operator configuration in the repository or public docs. Doctor warns when optional cloning packages or their build tooling are below fixed security floors."
```
